source_documents.title: Molecular packing-controlled mechanical-induced emission enhancement of tetraphenylethene functionalized pyrazoline derivatives

reference_evidence_units.quote: the enhanced emission was induced by the RIR and RIV.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-pyrazolines
reference_evidence_units.statement: AIE from restricted rotation and vibration of the TPE phenyls.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The results showed that the pyrazoline ring of the TPEB with MIEE property formed H-dimer aggregates with weak π-π stacking in solid state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Antiparallel H-dimers with weak π-π stacking.

reference_evidence_units.quote: After grinding, the synergistic effects of conformational planarization and destructive π-π interactions induced the fluorescence peak red-shifted and intensity enhanced.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB

reference_evidence_units.quote: The ΦF of the ground powder dramatically increased about 2.5-fold to 28.44%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB

reference_evidence_units.quote: The HOMOs of TPEB and TPEF were mainly located on the pyrazoline and phenyl of phenylhydrazine moiety
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPEB
reference_evidence_units.statement: HOMO on pyrazoline/phenylhydrazine, LUMO on TPE.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: AIE in THF/water from restricted rotation/vibration (RIR, RIV).

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: MIEE is explained by packing: grinding destroys the weak π-π stacking of the H-dimers and raises emission.

environment_context: crystal vs ground amorphous powder; conformational planarization on grinding (red shift)

contrast_group.varied_factor: non-conjugated para substituent on the pyrazoline 5-aryl (Br vs CN)
contrast_group.paper_difference: TPEB forms π-stacked H-dimers and brightens on grinding; TPECN forms loose J-aggregates and dims slightly.

reannotation.note: Previously no primary label; the paper's MIEE explanation is packing (π-π / H- vs J-aggregates), now AGGREGATE primary.
